# Refinzi 2.0

> Refinzi is an ambient Windows companion that rebuilds raw, vague thoughts into production-grade prompts in 2 seconds directly in-place across any Windows application.

## Core Features & Workflow
- [1-Click Primary Workflow](https://refinzi.com/#features): How Refinzi transforms active highlights in Windows into production prompts with 1-Click (Tap Ctrl+Alt+Space).
- [Interactive Demo](https://refinzi.com/#demo): Live side-by-side prompt rebuilds for ChatGPT, Gemini, Midjourney, and Cursor.
- [5-Block Blueprint (300ms Hold)](https://refinzi.com/#blueprint): Secondary hold mode synthesis for complete UI scaffolding, design tokens, copy, motion, and rules.
- [Pricing](https://refinzi.com/#pricing): Free BYOK (Bring Your Own Key) forever or Lifetime Pro with managed AI routing.
- [FAQ](https://refinzi.com/#faq): Windows system requirements, privacy guarantees, and supported AI models.

## Downloads & Repositories
- [Windows Installer](https://github.com/papada1472/Promptsmith/releases/download/v2.0.0/Refinzi-Setup-v2.0.0.exe): Official Windows 10 & 11 64-bit setup executable (v2.0.0).
- [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/papada1472/Promptsmith/releases): Release notes and verified checksums for Refinzi builds.
- [Source Repository](https://github.com/papada1472/Promptsmith): Official GitHub repository.
